alumni.name: James Voss
alumni.bio: Served his country with the longest spacewalk on record (8 hours and 56 minutes) on STS-102. Distinguished NASA career, Army Ranger, and Associate Dean of Engineering for External Affairs at Auburn University.

alumni.name: Lt. Gen. Ronald L. Burgess
alumni.bio: Retired from the U.S. Army in 2012 after a 38-year career. Continues to serve the U.S. intelligence community by providing leadership and strategic vision safeguarding national security.

alumni.name: Eric O'Neill
alumni.bio: Best known for his counterintelligence efforts to convict Robert Hanssen of spying against the United States, which became the subject of the movie "Breach".

alumni.name: James W. Rane
alumni.bio: Chairman, President, and CEO of the leading producer of pressure-treated lumber in the United States. Member of the Auburn University Board of Trustees since 1999.

alumni.name: Scott Yates
alumni.bio: Served in the US Army as a Communications specialist. As Associate Vice President at Cox Communications, Scott has been integral to the success of Beta Zeta over the last three decades.
